newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Espebepe false reports alleged.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Espebepe false reports alleged.

text.p: Poland's troubled construction firm Espebepe SA notified prosecutors in the northern city of Szczecin that its previous managers had allegedly released false financial reports, PAP news agency said on Tuesday.
It quoted the company's new director general Andrzej Hass as saying that the previous management had allegedly provided the bourse with false reports between February and April 1996.
Earlier this year, the Securities Commission notified prosecutors that the Espebepe managers had allegedly been releasing false reports in 1995.

Hass, who took over as Espebepe's president three months ago, was quoted as saying he had asked the Warsaw-based Nikon consulting firm to work out a deal with creditors on writing off some of its 74 million zloty debt.
The consultancy is also to prepare a development strategy for Espebepe.
Last month, Hass said his company needed to clinch a far-reaching debt writeoff deal with creditors to secure future operations.
